verdict.rationale: Qodo ships an official CLI (qodo-docs-5, qodo-docs-7, qodo-probe-4) and MCP server (qodo-docs-6, qodo-probe-3, qodo-probe-rt-1) that can be invoked headlessly to review changes and retrieve findings/rules, and PR review runs automatically once connected (qodo-docs-1), suggesting CI-friendly automation. However there is no explicit CI pipeline integration guide, no documented non-interactive/exit-code behavior for build gating, and no community confirmation of headless CI usage. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions/Jenkins recipe), documented headless exit-code/automation contract, independent hands-on confirmation of CI usage.
